Class TaskText

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.TaskText
public final class TaskText extends Object
The words the task screen puts together from what it shows: a time as the list writes it, the line under the title, what an empty list says, and a count of characters as the form keeps it. Kept apart from the controls so they can be tested without a window.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

    • lower

      public static String lower(String when)
      A time from when(Instant, Instant, ZoneId) as it reads inside a sentence: "today, 21:40" rather than "Today, 21:40". A date starts with its day's number and stays as it is.
      Parameters:
      when - the time as when wrote it
      Returns:
      the same words, starting in lower case
